site_signoff.fixes: Fixed a wrong call to action on the docket. The gold button's verb was the constant COMMENT NOW and its date word the constant CLOSES, hardcoded twice, in docket_build.py and again in site_build.py. That was right while every open item was a written comment window and wrong the moment one was not: the Anchorage crime-center ordinance's open room is a public hearing where a person speaks, and the page was telling readers to file a written comment before September 1st, which no source supports. The verb is now data on the item, from closed sets validated at build time, both surfaces render it through one implementation in docket_build.cta_html, and docket_dates_check's regex was widened to read the date behind either verb so the gate lost no strength. Verified: the two real comment windows still render COMMENT NOW, CLOSES AUG 28 and CLOSES SEP 14 unchanged, the new item renders TESTIFY, ON SEP 1, and docket_dates_check passes 291 assertions over 6 fixtures and 22 ledger items.
